question: Which rapper said she had no idea who a chart topping country star was?
story: Doja Cat was asked if she was a fan of Ella Langley, and she answered, I don't know what that is. According to Billboard, TMZ and E News, it happened on the Sundae Conversation podcast, where Doja said she does not really listen to country music and had genuinely never heard of the singer. Then she did something most people would not do. She pulled up Langley's hit Choosin Texas on a livestream and listened to it in front of everybody. Her verdict, reportedly, was that it was not her vibe, but that Langley has a very pretty voice. Langley found out the way everyone finds out things now. Online. On Thursday she posted a batch of photos from her tour with one caption. Ella Langley? What is that? Reports say there is no actual bad blood between them, which is somehow the funniest part of the whole thing.
